question: does the 2026-10-07 self-distillation degeneracy survive replacing the ridge teacher with the fine-tuned PromoterAtlas encoder?
why_the_ridge_arm_is_here: positive control -- same substrate, splits, perturbations, students and thresholds; only the teacher differs. It must reproduce ~1.0000 or this harness proves nothing.

substrate.teacher_was_finetuned_on: GSE144621 peak tiles -- a DIFFERENT dataset
substrate.circularity: base model cleared_vs_GSE108535 per wiki/promoteratlas_circularity_2026-10-31.md; the contaminated trspred-urtecho2018 head is NOT used -- verified in code

outcomes_defined_before_running.HARNESS_BROKEN_RIDGE_CONTROL_DID_NOT_REP: the ridge teacher did NOT recover agreement >= the floor in this harness, so the harness fails to reproduce the 2026-10-07 result and no statement about any other teacher is licensed
outcomes_defined_before_running.TEACHER_NOT_COMPETENT_ON_THIS_SUBSTRATE: the fine-tuned teacher does not clear standalone-GC + CONTROL_MUST_DROP on GSE108535, so a student failing to copy it would be copying noise and the agreement is uninterpretable
outcomes_defined_before_running.DEGENERACY_PERSISTS_WITH_A_LEARNED_TEACH: the linear student reproduces the LEARNED teacher too (agreement >= floor and |d rho| <= tol), so the measured degeneracy is NOT specific to a linear oracle and the block stands
outcomes_defined_before_running.DEGENERACY_DOES_NOT_TRANSFER_TO_THE_LEAR: the ridge control reproduced as required while the learned teacher's linear student did NOT, so the identity that produced 1.0000 does not hold for this teacher
outcomes_defined_before_running.DISTILLATION_HELPS_ON_THE_LEARNED_TEACHE: some student BEATS the learned teacher on held-out measured expression by > beat margin

verdict_detail: ridge control reproduced at [1.0, 1.0, 1.0] while the learned teacher's linear student reached (rate, agreement, d_rho) = [(0.02, 0.7322, -0.0915), (0.05, 0.7399, -0.085), (0.1, 0.7506, -0.0835)] -- below the 0.99 floor
honest_limits: ONE element axis, ONE checkpoint (one of ten seeds), ONE substrate. This bounds the MECHANISM, not the eventual value of distillation.
CROSS-DATASET: the teacher was fine-tuned on GSE144621 tiles and is scored here on GSE108535, so its rho here is NOT the 0.6405 the arm reported and the two must never be quoted interchangeably.
A non-transfer verdict says the 1.0000 IDENTITY does not hold for this teacher. It does NOT show self-distillation WORKS -- that needs the real-data validation half the ban's own wording requires.
Perturbation is uniform random point substitution; a generator's candidates are not uniform, so this exercises the method's mechanics and not the real off-distribution gap.
The students use the one-hot basis. A student with a RICHER basis than tested here might copy the network more closely, so this is a lower bound on copyability.
